item.description:
Keep working while Cove syncs

  • Archive, star, label and connect Calendar or Tasks while Cove catches up: syncing now runs quietly in the background.
  • Your changes show instantly and reach Gmail in order; a sync never undoes them, and if Gmail refuses one, only that change is undone.
  • Writing is much faster: drafts save after a short pause instead of on every keystroke.
  • Accents and other composed characters (á, ñ, ü) no longer send the cursor to the start.
  • Send now waits 4 seconds with an Undo bar, like Delete, instead of asking first.

Nothing is sent, archived or deleted without you.

Smoother catch-up

  • Cove now stays within Gmail's limits: after time away it catches up in small, steady batches, newest mail first, instead of hitting a wall.
  • Label changes from other devices sync without downloading those emails again, so catching up is much lighter.
  • If Gmail asks Cove to slow down, it keeps what it already has and continues on its own a minute later, with a quiet status instead of an alert.
  • Background downloads go gently on battery and faster when your Mac is plugged in.
  • Connecting Calendar or Tasks during a sync now works: Cove connects as soon as the sync finishes.

Nothing is sent, archived or deleted without you.

A calmer way in

  • The installer window is redesigned: open the disk image and a trail of dots shows the way from Cove into Applications.
  • Everything from 0.1.52 is included: agents you describe in a sentence, tasks from your email, Ask Cove inside the email, Spam and one-click Unsubscribe.

Nothing is sent, archived or deleted without you.
